summary: The diff implements all three requirements (REQ-14, REQ-15, REQ-16) with substantial coverage. Backend extends the Message type with an optional Blob image field, adds sendImageMessage, and migration support. Frontend adds EmojiPicker, ImagePreview, ImageModal components, updates MessageInput and ChatView. Nearly all acceptance criteria are met. One minor gap: the file picker button accepts image/* but the AC specifically calls out PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP. No significant hallucinated features beyond minor extras.

missing_requirements.requirement: The file input should be filtered to image types (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP) explicitly.
missing_requirements.reason: The MessageInput.tsx content is truncated so the explicit accept attribute value cannot be confirmed. The component description implies image/* is used which covers the intent but cannot be verified.

hallucinated_features.description: A Download button was added to the full-size ImageModal, allowing users to download images.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention a download button or download functionality for images. This feature was added beyond the specified requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module was added to handle schema migration of existing messages to include the new image field.
hallucinated_features.reason: While supporting existing data is implied by the constraint to not break existing functionality, an explicit migration module was not requested in any requirement.
